segments.ja536:1.2: Sabbosadhadharaṇidhare nekapupphamālyavitate gaja-gavaja mahiṃsa-ruru-camara-pasada-khagga-gokaṇṇa-sīha-byaggha-dīpi-accha-koka-taraccha-uddāra-kadalimiga- biḷāra-sasa-kaṇṇikānucariteākiṇṇanelamaṇḍalamahāvarāhanāgakulakareṇu [kaṇeru (sī. pī.)] -saṅghādhivuṭṭhe [vutthe (sī. pī.)] issamiga- sākhamiga-sarabhamiga-eṇīmiga-vātamiga-pasadamiga-purisālu [purisallu (sī. pī.)] -kimpurisa-yakkha-rakkhasanisevite amajjavamañjarīdhara-pahaṭṭha [brahaṭṭha (sī. pī.)] -pupphaphusitaggā [pupphitagga (sī. pī.)] nekapādapagaṇavitatekurara-cakora-vāraṇa-mayūra-parabhata- jīvañjīvaka-celāvakā-bhiṅkāra-karavīkamattavihaṅgagaṇa-satata [vihaṅgasata (sī. pī.)] sampaghuṭṭheañjana-manosilā-haritāla- hiṅgulakahema-rajatakanakānekadhātusatavinaddhapaṭimaṇḍitappadese evarūpe khalu, bho, ramme vanasaṇḍe kuṇālo nāma sakuṇo paṭivasati ativiya citto ativiya cittapattacchadano.
segments.ja536:2.1: Tasseva khalu, bho, kuṇālassa sakuṇassa aḍḍhuḍḍhāni itthisahassāni paricārikā dijakaññāyo. Atha khalu, bho, dve dijakaññāyo kaṭṭhaṃ mukhena ḍaṃsitvā [ḍasitvā (sī. pī.) evamuparipi] taṃ kuṇālaṃ sakuṇaṃ majjhe nisīdāpetvā uḍḍenti [ḍenti (sī. pī.) evamuparipi]–
segments.ja536:2.2: “mā naṃ kuṇālaṃ sakuṇaṃ addhānapariyāyapathe kilamatho ubbāhetthā”ti [ubbāhethāti (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja536:3.1: Pañcasatā [pañcasata (pī.)] dijakaññāyo heṭṭhato heṭṭhato uḍḍenti –[ḍenti (sī. pī.) evamuparipi]“sacāyaṃ kuṇālo sakuṇo āsanā paripatissati, mayaṃ taṃ pakkhehi paṭiggahessāmāti.
segments.ja536:4.1: Pañcasatā dijakaññāyo uparūpari uḍḍenti –[ḍenti (sī. pī.) evamuparipi]“mā naṃ kuṇālaṃ sakuṇaṃ ātapo paritāpesī”ti [parikāpīti (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja536:5.1: Pañcasatā pañcasatā [sī. pī. potthakesu “pañcasatā”ti sakideva āgataṃ] dijakaññāyo ubhatopassena uḍḍenti –[ḍenti (sī. pī.) evamuparipi]“mā naṃ kuṇālaṃ sakuṇaṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā tiṇaṃ vā rajo vā vāto vā ussāvo vā upapphusī”ti.
segments.ja536:6.2: “mā naṃ kuṇālaṃ sakuṇaṃ gopālakā vā pasupālakā vā tiṇahārakā vā kaṭṭhahārakā vā vanakammikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā [kathalāya vā (ka.)] pāṇinā vā ()[(pāsāṇena vā)(syā.)] leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā sakkharāhi vā [sakkharāya vā (sī.)] pahāraṃ adaṃsu.
segments.ja536:6.3: Māyaṃ kuṇālo sakuṇo gacchehi vā latāhi vā rukkhehi vā sākhāhi vā [idaṃ padadvayaṃ sī. pī. potthakesu natthi] thambhehi vā pāsāṇehi vā balavantehi vā pakkhīhi saṅgamesī”ti [saṅgāmesīti (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja536:7.1: Pañcasatā dijakaññāyo pacchato pacchato uḍḍenti saṇhāhi sakhilāhi mañjūhi madhurāhi vācāhi samudācarantiyo –
segments.ja536:9.1: Atha khalu, bho, tā [natthi sī. pī. potthakesu] dijakaññāyo taṃ kuṇālaṃ sakuṇaṃ ārāmeneva ārāmaṃ uyyāneneva uyyānaṃ nadītittheneva nadītitthaṃ pabbatasikhareneva pabbatasikharaṃ ambavaneneva ambavanaṃ jambuvaneneva jambuvanaṃ labujavaneneva labujavanaṃ nāḷikerasañcāriyeneva [sañjādiyeneva (pī.)] nāḷikerasañcāriyaṃ khippameva abhisambhonti ratitthāya [ratatthāya (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja536:10.1: Atha khalu, bho, kuṇālo sakuṇo tāhi dijakaññāhi divasaṃ paribyūḷho evaṃ apasādeti –
segments.ja536:10.2: “nassatha tumhe vasaliyo, vinassatha tumhe vasaliyo, coriyo dhuttiyo asatiyo lahucittāyo katassa appaṭikārikāyo anilo viya yenakāmaṃgamāyo”ti.
segments.ja536:11.1: Tasseva khalu, bho, himavato pabbatarājassa puratthimadisābhāge susukhumasunipuṇagirippabhava [ppabhavā (sī. pī.)]– haritupayantiyo.
segments.ja536:12.1: Uppala paduma kumuda naḷina satapatta sogandhika mandālaka [mandālava (sī. pī.), mandārava (ka.)] sampativirūḷhasucigandha manuññamāvakappadese [pāvakappadese (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja536:13.1: Kuravaka-mucalinda-ketaka-vedisa-vañjula [vetasamañjula (sī.)] -punnāgabakula-tilaka-piyaka-hasanasāla-saḷalacampaka asoka-nāgarukkha-tirīṭi-bhujapatta-lodda-candanoghavanekāḷāgaru-padmaka-piyaṅgu-devadārukacocagahane kakudhakuṭajaaṅkola-kaccikāra [kacchikāra (ka.)] -kaṇikāra-kaṇṇikāra-kanavera-koraṇḍaka-koviḷāra-kiṃsuka-yodhika vanamallika [navamallika (sī. pī.)] -manaṅgaṇa-manavajja-bhaṇḍi-surucira-bhaginimālāmalyadhare jātisumanamadhugandhika- [madhukabandhuka (ka.)] dhanutakkāri [dhanukāri (sī.), dhanukārika (pī.)] tālīsa-tagaramusīrakoṭṭha-kacchavitate atimuttakasaṃkusumitalatāvitatapaṭimaṇḍitappadese haṃsa-pilava-kādamba-kāraṇḍavābhinadite vijjādhara-siddha [sindhava (sī. pī.)] -samaṇa-tāpasagaṇādhivuṭṭhe varadeva-yakkha-rakkhasa-dānava-gandhabba-kinnaramahoragānuciṇṇappadese evarūpe khalu, bho, ramme vanasaṇḍe puṇṇamukho nāma phussakokilo paṭivasati ativiya madhuragiro vilāsitanayano mattakkho [savilāsitanayanamattakkho (ka.)].
segments.ja536:14.1: Tasseva khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa aḍḍhuḍḍhāni itthisatāni paricārikā dijakaññāyo.
segments.ja536:14.2: Atha khalu, bho, dve dijakaññāyo kaṭṭhaṃ mukhena ḍaṃsitvā taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ majjhe nisīdāpetvā uḍḍenti –
segments.ja536:14.3: “mā naṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ addhānapariyāyapathe kilamatho ubbāhetthā”ti.
segments.ja536:15.2: “sacāyaṃ puṇṇamukho phussakokilo āsanā paripatissati, mayaṃ taṃ pakkhehi paṭiggahessāmā”ti.
segments.ja536:17.2: “mā naṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā tiṇaṃ vā rajo vā vāto vā ussāvo vā upapphusī”ti.
segments.ja536:18.2: “mā naṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ gopālakā vā pasupālakā vā tiṇahārakā vā kaṭṭhahārakā vā vanakammikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kathalāya vā pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā sakkharāhi vā pahāraṃ adaṃsu.
segments.ja536:18.3: Māyaṃ puṇṇamukho phussakokilo gacchehi vā latāhi vā rukkhehi vā sākhāhi vā thambhehi vā pāsāṇehi vā balavantehi vā pakkhīhi saṅgāmesī”ti.
segments.ja536:19.1: Paññāsa dijakaññāyo pacchato pacchato uḍḍenti saṇhāhi sakhilāhi mañjūhi madhurāhi vācāhi samudācarantiyo –
segments.ja536:21.1: Atha khalu, bho, tā dijakaññāyo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ ārāmeneva ārāmaṃ uyyāneneva uyyānaṃ nadītittheneva nadītitthaṃ pabbatasikhareneva pabbatasikharaṃ ambavaneneva ambavanaṃ jambuvaneneva jambuvanaṃ labujavaneneva labujavanaṃ nāḷikerasañcāriyeneva nāḷikerasañcāriyaṃ khippameva abhisambhonti ratitthāya.
segments.ja536:22.1: Atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukho phussakokilo tāhi dijakaññāhi divasaṃ paribyūḷho evaṃ pasaṃsati –
segments.ja536:22.2: “sādhu, sādhu, bhaginiyo, etaṃ kho, bhaginiyo, tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kuladhītānaṃ, yaṃ tumhe bhattāraṃ paricareyyāthā”ti.
segments.ja536:23.1: Atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukho phussakokilo yena kuṇālo sakuṇo tenupasaṅkami.
segments.ja536:23.2: Addasaṃsu kho kuṇālassa sakuṇassa paricārikā dijakaññāyo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ;
segments.ja536:23.3: disvāna yena puṇṇamukho phussakokilo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.ja536:23.4: “ayaṃ, samma puṇṇamukha, kuṇālo sakuṇo ativiya pharuso ativiya pharusavāco, appevanāma tavampi āgamma piyavācaṃ labheyyāmā”ti.
segments.ja536:23.5: “Appevanāma, bhaginiyo”ti vatvā yena kuṇālo sakuṇo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā kuṇālena sakuṇena saddhiṃ paṭisammoditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.ja536:23.6: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho puṇṇamukho phussakokilo taṃ kuṇālaṃ sakuṇaṃ etadavoca –
segments.ja536:23.7: “kissa tvaṃ, samma kuṇāla, itthīnaṃ sujātānaṃ kuladhītānaṃ sammāpaṭipannānaṃ micchāpaṭipanno’ si [paṭipanno (sī. pī.)]?
segments.ja536:23.8: Amanāpabhāṇīnampi kira, samma kuṇāla, itthīnaṃ manāpabhāṇinā bhavitabbaṃ, kimaṅga pana manāpabhāṇīnan”ti!
segments.ja536:24.1: Evaṃ vutte, kuṇālo sakuṇo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ evaṃ apasādesi –
segments.ja536:24.2: “nassa tvaṃ, samma jamma vasala, vinassa tvaṃ, samma jamma vasala, ko nu tayā viyatto jāyājinenā”ti.
segments.ja536:24.3: Evaṃ apasādito ca pana puṇṇamukho phussakokilo tatoyeva [tato heva (sī. pī.)] paṭinivatti.
segments.ja536:25.1: Atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa aparena samayena nacirasseva [acirasseva accayena (ka.)] kharo ābādho uppajji lohitapakkhandikā. Bāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā [maraṇantikā (syā.)].
segments.ja536:25.2: Atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa paricārikānaṃ dijakaññānaṃ etadahosi –
segments.ja536:25.3: “ābādhiko kho ayaṃ puṇṇamukho phussakokilo, appevanāma imamhā ābādhā vuṭṭhaheyyā”ti ekaṃ adutiyaṃ ohāya yena kuṇālo sakuṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
segments.ja536:25.4: Addasā kho kuṇālo sakuṇo tā dijakaññāyo dūratova āgacchantiyo, disvāna tā dijakaññāyo etadavoca –
segments.ja536:25.6: “Ābādhiko kho, samma kuṇāla, puṇṇamukho phussakokilo appevanāma tamhā ābādhā vuṭṭhaheyyā”ti.
segments.ja536:25.7: Evaṃ vutte, kuṇālo sakuṇo tā dijakaññāyo evaṃ apasādesi –
segments.ja536:25.8: “nassatha tumhe vasaliyo, vinassatha tumhe vasaliyo, coriyo dhuttiyo asatiyo lahucittāyo katassa appaṭikārikāyo anilo viya yenakāmaṃgamāyo”ti;
segments.ja536:25.9: vatvā yena puṇṇamukho phussakokilo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ etadavoca –
segments.ja536:26.1: Atha khalu, bho kuṇālo sakuṇo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ pakkhehi ca mukhatuṇḍakena ca pariggahetvā vuṭṭhāpetvā nānābhesajjāni pāyāpesi.
segments.ja536:26.2: Atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa so ābādho paṭippassambhīti.
segments.ja536:26.3: Atha khalu, bho, kuṇālo sakuṇo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ gilānavuṭṭhitaṃ [gilānāvuṭṭhitaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] aciravuṭṭhitaṃ gelaññā etadavoca –
segments.ja536:27.1: “Diṭṭhā mayā, samma puṇṇamukha, kaṇhā dvepitikā pañcapatikāya chaṭṭhe purise cittaṃ paṭibandhantiyā, yadidaṃ kabandhe [kavandhe (sī. pī.)] pīṭhasappimhīti.
segments.ja536:28.1: “Athajjuno nakulo bhīmaseno [bhimmaseno (sī. syā. pī.)], yudhiṭṭhilo sahadevo [sīhadevo (ka.)] ca rājā;
segments.ja536:28.3: Ete patī pañca matticca nārī, akāsi khujjavāmanakena [khujjavāmanena (pī.)] pāpan”ti.
segments.ja536:29.1: “Diṭṭhā mayā, samma puṇṇamukha, saccatapāpī [saccatapāvī (sī. pī.), pañcatapāvī (syā.)] nāma samaṇī susānamajjhe vasantī catutthabhattaṃ pariṇāmayamānā surādhuttakena [tulāputtakena (sī. pī.), sā surādhuttakena (ka.)] pāpamakāsi.
segments.ja536:30.1: “Diṭṭhā mayā, samma puṇṇamukha, kākavatī [kākātī (sī.), kākāti (pī.)] nāma devī samuddamajjhe vasantī bhariyā venateyyassa naṭakuverena pāpamakāsi.
segments.ja536:31.1: Diṭṭhā mayā, samma puṇṇamukha, kuruṅgadevī [kuraṅgavī (sī. pī.)] nāma lomasuddarī [lomasundarī (sī. syā. pī.)] eḷikakumāraṃ [eḷamārakaṃ (sī.), eḷakakumāraṃ (syā.), eḷakamāraṃ (pī.)] kāmayamānā chaḷaṅgakumāradhanantevāsinā pāpamakāsi.
segments.ja536:32.1: Evañhetaṃ mayā ñātaṃ, brahmadattassa mātaraṃ [mātukā (syā.)] ohāya kosalarājaṃ pañcālacaṇḍena pāpamakāsi.
segments.ja536:33.1: “Etā ca aññā ca akaṃsu pāpaṃ, tasmāhamitthīnaṃ na vissase nappasaṃse;
segments.ja536:33.3: Mahī yathā jagati samānarattā, vasundharā itarītarāpatiṭṭhā [itarītarānaṃ patiṭṭhā (syā.), ittarītarappatiṭṭhā (?)];
segments.ja536:33.5: Sabbasahā aphandanā akuppā, tathitthiyo tāyo na vissase naro.
segments.ja536:34.1: “Sīho yathā lohitamaṃsabhojano, vāḷamigo pañcāvudho [pañcahattho (sī. pī.)] suruddho;
segments.ja536:34.3: Pasayhakhādī parahiṃsane rato, tathitthiyo tāyo na vissase naro.
segments.ja536:35.1: “Na khalu [na khalu bho (syā. ka.)], samma puṇṇamukha, vesiyo nāriyo gamaniyo, na hetā bandhakiyo nāma, vadhikāyo nāma etāyo, yadidaṃ vesiyo nāriyo gamaniyo”ti.
segments.ja536:36.1: “Coro [corā (sī. syā. pī.)] viya veṇikatā, madirāva [madirā viya (sī. syā.), madiriva (pī.)] diddhā [diṭṭhā (ka.), visaduṭṭhā (syā.)] vāṇijo [vāṇijā (pī.)] viya vācāsanthutiyo, issasiṅghamiva viparivattāyo [parivattāyo (pī.), viparivattāro (ka.)], uragāmiva dujivhāyo, sobbhamiva paṭicchannā, pātālamiva duppūrā rakkhasī viya duttosā, yamovekantahāriyo, sikhīriva sabbabhakkhā, nadīriva sabbavāhī, anilo viya yenakāmaṃcarā, neru viya avisesakarā, visarukkho viya niccaphalitāyo”ti.
segments.ja536:37.3: Issasiṅghamiva parivattā [mivāvaṭṭo (sī.), mivāvattā (pī.)], dujivhā [dujjivha (pī.)] urago viya.
segments.ja536:38.3: Rakkhasī viya duttosā, yamovekantahāriyo. [yathā sikhī nadīvāho, anilo kāmacāravā;§ nerūva avisesā ca, visarukkho viya niccaphalā;§ nāsayanti ghare bhogaṃ, ratanānantakaritthi yoti;(sī. syā.)]
segments.ja536:39.3: Visarukkho viya niccaphalā, nāsayanti ghare bhogaṃ;
segments.ja536:39.5: Ratanantakaritthiyo”ti [yathā sikhī nadīvāho, anilo kāmacāravā;§ nerūva avisesā ca, visarukkho viya niccaphalā;§ nāsayanti ghare bhogaṃ, ratanānantakaritthi yoti;(sī. syā.)].
segments.ja536:40.1: “Cattārimāni, samma puṇṇamukha, yāni (vatthūni kicce jāte anatthacarāni bhavanti; tāni)[() sī. syā. potthakesu na dissati] parakule na vāsetabbāni – goṇaṃ dhenuṃ yānaṃ bhariyā.
segments.ja536:40.4: Cattāri etāni paṇḍito dhanāni [yāni (sī. syā. pī.)] gharā na vippavāsaye.
segments.ja536:41.1: ‘Goṇaṃ dhenuñca yānañca, bhariyaṃ ñātikule na vāsaye;
segments.ja536:41.3: Bhañjanti rathaṃ ayānakā, ativāhena hananti puṅgavaṃ;
segments.ja536:41.5: Dohena hananti vacchakaṃ, bhariyā ñātikule padussatī’”ti.
segments.ja536:42.1: “Cha imāni, samma puṇṇamukha, yāni (vatthūni)[() sī. pī. potthakesu nu dissati] kicce jāte anatthacarāni bhavanti –
segments.ja536:43.1: ‘Aguṇaṃ dhanu ñātikule ca bhariyā, pāraṃ nāvā akkhabhaggañca yānaṃ;
segments.ja536:43.3: Dūre mitto pāpasahāyako ca, kicce jāte anatthacarāni bhavan’”ti.
segments.ja536:44.1: “Aṭṭhahi khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī sāmikaṃ avajānāti.
segments.ja536:44.2: Daliddatā, āturatā, jiṇṇatā, surāsoṇḍatā, muddhatā, pamattatā, sabbakiccesu anuvattanatā, sabbadhanaanuppadānena – imehi khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, aṭṭhahi ṭhānehi itthī sāmikaṃ avajānāti.
segments.ja536:45.3: Pamattaṃ muddhapattañca, sabbakiccesu [rattaṃ kiccesu (sī. pī.)] hāpanaṃ;
segments.ja536:46.1: “Navahi khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī padosamāharati.
segments.ja536:46.2: Ārāmagamanasīlā ca hoti, uyyānagamanasīlā ca hoti, nadītitthagamanasīlā ca hoti, ñātikulagamanasīlā ca hoti, parakulagamanasīlā ca hoti, ādāsadussamaṇḍanānuyogamanuyuttasīlā ca hoti, majjapāyinī ca hoti, nillokanasīlā ca hoti, sadvāraṭhāyinī [padvāraṭṭhāyinī (sī. syā. pī.)] ca hoti – imehi khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, navahi ṭhānehi itthī padosamāharatīti.
segments.ja536:47.1: ‘Ārāmasīlā ca [ārāmasīlā (sī. pī.)] uyyānaṃ, nadī ñāti parakulaṃ;
segments.ja536:49.1: “Cattālīsāya [cattālīsāyi (pī. ka.)] khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī purisaṃ accācarati [accāvadati (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja536:49.2: Vijambhati, vinamati, vilasati, vilajjati, nakhena nakhaṃ ghaṭṭeti, pādena pādaṃ akkamati, kaṭṭhena pathaviṃ vilikhati [likhati (sī. pī.)], dārakaṃ ullaṅghati ullaṅghāpeti [dārakaṃ ullaṅgheti olaṅgheti (sī. pī.)], kīḷati kīḷāpeti, cumbati cumbāpeti, bhuñjati bhuñjāpeti, dadāti, yācati, katamanukaroti, uccaṃ bhāsati, nīcaṃ bhāsati, aviccaṃ bhāsati, viviccaṃ bhāsati, naccena gītena vāditena rodanena [roditena (sī. pī.)] vilasitena vibhūsitena jagghati, pekkhati, kaṭiṃ cāleti, guyhabhaṇḍakaṃ sañcāleti, ūruṃ vivarati, ūruṃ pidahati, thanaṃ dasseti, kacchaṃ dasseti, nābhiṃ dasseti, akkhiṃ nikhanati, bhamukaṃ ukkhipati, oṭṭhaṃ upalikhati [oṭṭhaṃ palikhati jivhaṃ palikhati (sī. pī.)], jivhaṃ nillāleti, dussaṃ muñcati, dussaṃ paṭibandhati, sirasaṃ muñcati, sirasaṃ bandhati – imehi khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, cattālīsāya ṭhānehi itthī purisaṃ accācarati.
segments.ja536:50.1: “Pañcavīsāya [pañcavīsāhi (pī. ka.)] khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī paduṭṭhā veditabbā bhavati.
segments.ja536:50.2: Sāmikassa pavāsaṃ vaṇṇeti, pavuṭṭhaṃ na sarati, āgataṃ nābhinandati, avaṇṇaṃ tassa bhaṇati, vaṇṇaṃ tassa na bhaṇati, anatthaṃ tassa carati, atthaṃ tassa na carati, akiccaṃ tassa karoti, kiccaṃ tassa na karoti, paridahitvā sayati, parammukhī nipajjati, parivattakajātā kho pana hoti kuṅkumiyajātā, dīghaṃ assasati, dukkhaṃ vedayati, uccārapassāvaṃ abhiṇhaṃ gacchati, vilomamācarati, parapurisasaddaṃ sutvā kaṇṇasotaṃ vivaramodahati [vivarati kamodahati (pī.)], nihatabhogā kho pana hoti, paṭivissakehi santhavaṃ karoti, nikkhantapādā kho pana hoti, visikhānucārinī aticārinī kho pana hoti, niccaṃ [natthi sī. syā. pī. potthakesu] sāmike agāravā paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappā, abhiṇhaṃ dvāre tiṭṭhati, kacchāni aṅgāni thanāni dasseti, disodisaṃ gantvā pekkhati – imehi khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, pañcavīsāya [pañcavīsāhi (ka.)] ṭhānehi itthī paduṭṭhā veditabbā bhavati.
segments.ja536:51.1: ‘Pavāsaṃ tassa vaṇṇeti, gataṃ tassa na socati [pavāsa’ massa vaṇṇeti gatiṃ nānusocati (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja536:51.4: Bhattāravaṇṇaṃ na kadāci bhāsati, ete paduṭṭhāya bhavanti lakkhaṇā.
segments.ja536:52.1: ‘Anatthaṃ tassa carati asaññatā, atthañca hāpeti akiccakārinī;
segments.ja536:52.3: Paridahitvā sayati parammukhī, ete paduṭṭhāya bhavanti lakkhaṇā.
segments.ja536:53.1: ‘Parivattajātā ca [parāvattakajātā ca (sī.)] bhavati kuṅkumī, dīghañca assasati dukkhavedinī;
segments.ja536:53.3: Uccārapassāvamabhiṇhaṃ gacchati, ete paduṭṭhāya bhavanti lakkhaṇā.
segments.ja536:54.3: Nihatabhogā ca karoti santhavaṃ, ete paduṭṭhāya bhavanti lakkhaṇā.
segments.ja536:55.1: ‘Kicchena laddhaṃ kasirābhataṃ [kasirenābhataṃ (sī.)] dhanaṃ, vittaṃ vināseti dukkhena sambhataṃ;
segments.ja536:55.3: Paṭivissakehi ca karoti santhavaṃ, ete paduṭṭhāya bhavanti lakkhaṇā.
segments.ja536:56.1: ‘Nikkhantapādā visikhānucārinī, niccañca sāmimhi [niccaṃ sasāmimhi (pī. ka.)] paduṭṭhamānasā;
segments.ja536:56.3: Aticārinī hoti apetagāravā [tatheva’ gāravā (sī. pī.)], ete paduṭṭhāya bhavanti lakkhaṇā.
segments.ja536:57.1: ‘Abhikkhaṇaṃ tiṭṭhati dvāramūle, thanāni kacchāni ca dassayantī;
segments.ja536:57.3: Disodisaṃ pekkhati bhantacittā, ete paduṭṭhāya bhavanti lakkhaṇā.
segments.ja536:59.1: ‘Sace labhetha khaṇaṃ vā raho vā, nivātakaṃ vāpi labhetha tādisaṃ;
segments.ja536:59.3: Sabbāva itthī kayiruṃ nu [kareyyu no (sī.), kareyyuṃ no (pī.)] pāpaṃ, aññaṃ alattha [aladdhā (syā. pī. ka.)] pīṭhasappināpi saddhiṃ.
segments.ja536:60.3: Sabbattha nāpītikarāpi [sabba’ ttanā’ pītikārāpi (sī. syā.)] ce siyā [siyuṃ (syā.)], na vissase titthasamā hi nāriyo”ti.
segments.ja536:61.1: ‘Yaṃ ve [yañca (syā. ka.)] disvā kaṇḍarīkinnarānaṃ [kinnarakinnarīnaṃ (syā.), kinnarīkinnarānaṃ (ka.)], sabbitthiyo na ramanti agāre;
segments.ja536:61.3: Taṃ tādisaṃ maccaṃ cajitvā bhariyā, aññaṃ disvā purisaṃ pīṭhasappiṃ.
segments.ja536:62.1: ‘Bakassa ca bāvarikassa [pāvārikassa (sī.), bāvariyassa (syā.)] rañño, accantakāmānugatassa bhariyā;
segments.ja536:62.3: Avācarī [accācari (syā.), anācari (ka.)] paṭṭhavasānugassa [baddhavasānugassa (sī. syā.), pattavasānugatassa (ka.)], kaṃ vāpi itthī nāticare tadaññaṃ.
segments.ja536:63.3: Avācarī paṭṭhavasānugassa, taṃ vāpi sā nājjhagā kāmakāminī.
segments.ja536:65.1: ‘Na tā pajānanti kataṃ na kiccaṃ, na mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhātaraṃ vā;
segments.ja536:65.3: Anariyā samatikkantadhammā, sasseva cittassa vasaṃ vajanti.
segments.ja536:66.1: ‘Cirānuvuṭṭhampi [cirānuvutthampi (sī. pī.)] piyaṃ manāpaṃ, anukampakaṃ pāṇasamampi bhattuṃ [santaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja536:66.3: Āvāsu kiccesu ca naṃ jahanti, tasmāhamitthīnaṃ na vissasāmi.
segments.ja536:67.1: ‘Thīnañhi cittaṃ yathā vānarassa, kannappakannaṃ yathā rukkhachāyā;
segments.ja536:67.3: Calācalaṃ hadayamitthiyānaṃ, cakkassa nemi viya parivattati.
segments.ja536:68.1: ‘Yadā tā passanti samekkhamānā, ādeyyarūpaṃ purisassa vittaṃ;
segments.ja536:68.3: Saṇhāhi vācāhi nayanti menaṃ, kambojakā jalajeneva assaṃ.
segments.ja536:69.1: ‘Yadā na passanti samekkhamānā, ādeyyarūpaṃ purisassa vittaṃ;
segments.ja536:69.3: Samantato naṃ parivajjayanti, tiṇṇo nadīpāragatova kullaṃ.
segments.ja536:70.3: Sevanti hetā piyamappiyañca, nāvā yathā orakūlaṃ [orakulaṃ (sī.) evamuparipi] parañca.
segments.ja536:71.1: ‘Na tā ekassa na dvinnaṃ, āpaṇova pasārito;
segments.ja536:71.3: Yo tā mayhanti maññeyya, vātaṃ jālena bādhaye [bandhaye (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja536:72.1: ‘Yathā nadī ca pantho ca, pānāgāraṃ sabhā papā;
segments.ja536:72.3: Evaṃ lokitthiyo nāma, velā tāsaṃ na vijjati [kesuci potthakesu imissā gāthāya pubbaddhāparaddhaṃ vipariyāyena dissati].
segments.ja536:74.1: ‘Ghatāsanaṃ kuñjaraṃ kaṇhasappaṃ, muddhābhisittaṃ pamadā ca sabbā;
segments.ja536:74.3: Ete naro [etena so (pī.)] niccayato [niccayatto (sī. pī.)] bhajetha, tesaṃ have dubbidu sabbabhāvo [saccabhāvo (syā.)].
segments.ja536:75.1: ‘Naccantavaṇṇā na bahūnaṃ kantā, na dakkhiṇā pamadā sevitabbā;
segments.ja536:75.3: Na parassa bhariyā na dhanassa hetu, etitthiyo pañca na sevitabbā’”.
segments.ja536:76.1: Atha khalu, bho, ānando gijjharājā kuṇālassa sakuṇassa ādimajjhakathāpariyosānaṃ [ādimajjhagāthāpariyosānaṃ (syā. ka.)] viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.ja536:77.1: “Puṇṇampi cemaṃ pathaviṃ dhanena, dajjitthiyā puriso sammatāya;
segments.ja536:77.3: Laddhā khaṇaṃ atimaññeyya tampi, tāsaṃ vasaṃ asatīnaṃ na gacche.
segments.ja536:78.3: Āvāsu kiccesu ca naṃ jahanti, tasmāhamitthīnaṃ [tasmā hi itthīnaṃ (sī. pī.)] na vissasāmi.
segments.ja536:79.1: “Na vissase icchati manti poso, na vissase rodati me sakāse;
segments.ja536:79.3: Sevanti hetā piyamappiyañca, nāvā yathā orakūlaṃ parañca.
segments.ja536:80.3: Na vissase rājānaṃ sakhā [rājā sakhā (sī. pī.)] mamanti, na vissase itthi dasanna mātaraṃ.
segments.ja536:81.3: Accantapemānugatassa bhariyā, na vissase titthasamā hi nāriyo.
segments.ja536:82.1: “Haneyyuṃ chindeyyuṃ chedāpeyyumpi [haneyyu chindeyyuṃpi chadayeyyuṃ (sī. pī.), haneyyuṃpi chindeyyuṃpi chedāpeyyuṃpi (syā.)], kaṇṭhepi [kaṇṭhampi (sī. syā.)] chetvā rudhiraṃ piveyyuṃ;
segments.ja536:82.3: Mā dīnakāmāsu asaññatāsu, bhāvaṃ kare gaṅgatitthūpamāsu.
segments.ja536:83.1: “Musā tāsaṃ yathā saccaṃ, saccaṃ tāsaṃ yathā musā;
segments.ja536:85.1: “Coriyo kathinā [kaṭhinā (sī. syā. pī.)] hetā, vāḷā ca lapasakkharā;
segments.ja536:85.3: Na tā kiñci na jānanti, yaṃ manussesu vañcanaṃ.
segments.ja536:86.1: “Asā lokitthiyo nāma, velā tāsaṃ na vijjati;
segments.ja536:86.3: Sārattā ca pagabbhā ca, sikhī sabbaghaso yathā.
segments.ja536:87.3: Sevanti hetā piyamappiyañca, nāvā yathā orakūlaṃ parañca.
segments.ja536:90.3: Anugacchanti [gacchanti (pī.)] anupatanti, dhanahetu hi nāriyo”ti [dhanahetu ca nāriyo (syā.), dhanahetu nāriyo (pī.)].
segments.ja536:91.1: Atha khalu, bho, nārado devabrāhmaṇo ānandassa gijjharājassa ādimajjhakathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.ja536:92.1: “Cattārome na pūrenti, te me suṇātha bhāsato;
segments.ja536:92.3: Samuddo brāhmaṇo rājā, itthī cāpi dijampati.
segments.ja536:93.3: Tā samuddaṃ na pūrenti, ūnattā hi na pūrati.
segments.ja536:94.3: Bhiyyopi sutamiccheyya, ūnattā hi na pūrati.
segments.ja536:95.5: Pāraṃ samuddaṃ pattheti, ūnattā hi na pūrati.
segments.ja536:96.5: Kareyya navame chandaṃ, ūnattā hi na pūrati.
segments.ja536:97.3: Sabbitthiyo kaṇṭakānaṃva sākhā, sabbitthiyo dhanahetu vajanti.
segments.ja536:98.1: “Vātañca jālena naro parāmase, osiñcaye [osañciyā (sī. pī.)] sāgaramekapāṇinā;
segments.ja536:98.3: Sakena hatthena kareyya ghosaṃ [sakena kālena haneyya ghosanaṃ (pī.)], yo sabbabhāvaṃ pamadāsu osaje.
segments.ja536:102.1: “Yaṃ etā [yañcetā (syā.)] upasevanti, chandasā vā dhanena vā;
segments.ja536:103.1: Atha khalu, bho, kuṇālo sakuṇo nāradassa devabrāhmaṇassa ādimajjhakathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.ja536:104.3: Uggatejamuragampi āside, eko ekāya pamadāya nālape [eko ekapamadaṃ hi nālape (pī.) eko ekapamādāya nālape (?)].
segments.ja536:106.1: “Natthi tāsaṃ vinayo na saṃvaro, majjamaṃsaniratā [majjamaṃsābhiratā (ka.)] asaññatā;
segments.ja536:106.3: Tā gilanti purisassa pābhataṃ, sāgareva makaraṃ timiṅgalo [timiṅgilo (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja536:108.1: “Yaṃ naraṃ upalapenti [uparamanti (sī. pī.), palāpenti (ka.)] nāriyo, chandasā va ratiyā dhanena vā;
segments.ja536:108.3: Jātavedasadisampi tādisaṃ, rāgadosavadhiyo [rāgadosavatiyo (sī. pī.)] dahanti naṃ.
segments.ja536:109.1: “Aḍḍhaṃ ñatvā purisaṃ mahaddhanaṃ, osaranti sadhanā sahattanā;
segments.ja536:110.3: Uhasanti [ūhasanti (sī. pī.), ohasanti (syā.)] pahasanti nāriyo, sambarova [saṃvarova (syā. pī. ka.)] satamāyakovidā.
segments.ja536:111.3: Rakkhitā aticaranti sāmikaṃ, dānavaṃva hadayantarassitā [hadayantanissitā (ka.), hadayantaranissitā (syā.)].
segments.ja536:112.1: “Tejavāpi hi naro vicakkhaṇo, sakkato bahujanassa pūjito;
segments.ja536:112.3: Nārinaṃ vasagato na bhāsati, rāhunā upahatova candimā.
segments.ja536:113.1: “Yaṃ kareyya kupito diso disaṃ, duṭṭhacitto vasamāgataṃ ariṃ [ari (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja536:113.3: Tena bhiyyo byasanaṃ nigacchati, nārinaṃ vasagato apekkhavā.
segments.ja536:114.3: Hīnamevupagatā hi nāriyo, tā ramanti kuṇapeva makkhikā.
segments.ja536:115.1: “Tā kulesu visikhantaresu vā, rājadhāninigamesu vā puna [vā pana (syā.)];
segments.ja536:117.1: “So idha garahito parattha ca, dummatī upahato [upagato (sī. pī.)] sakammunā;
segments.ja536:119.3: Nāsayanti pamadā pamādinaṃ, duggatiñca paṭipādayanti naṃ.
segments.ja536:120.3: Soṇṇabyamhanilayā [suvaṇṇabyamhanilayā (syā. ka.), sovaṇṇabyamhanilayā (pī.)] ca accharā, ye caranti pamadāhanatthikā.
segments.ja536:121.1: “Kāmadhātusamatikkamā gati, rūpadhātuyā bhāvo [rūpadhātuyā bhavo (sī.), rūpadhātusambhavo (syā.)] na dullabho;
segments.ja536:122.3: Nibbutehi sucihī na dullabhaṃ, ye caranti pamadāhanatthikā”ti.
